rungs.title: Associate Architect
rungs.summary: Learning to design systems and write down why.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the common patterns and the company's systems; learns to see trade-offs.
rungs.delivery: Drafts designs for well-bounded problems and updates the architecture records.
rungs.leadership: Takes review comments well and explains designs to the engineers who build them.

rungs.title: Solution Architect
rungs.summary: Designs a whole solution and gets it built the way it was drawn.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in architecture, data, security and DevOps; chooses technology for reasons they can state.
rungs.delivery: Designs and hands over a complete solution, then follows it through delivery.
rungs.leadership: Builds trust with product, delivery and engineering; runs design reviews.

rungs.title: Senior Architect
rungs.summary: Owns the architecture of a product or domain.
rungs.knowledge: Weighs cost, risk and operability across infrastructure, security operations and AI.
rungs.delivery: Owns a product's architecture, its roadmap and its technical debt.
rungs.leadership: Leads projects across teams and mentors solution architects.

rungs.title: Principal Architect
rungs.summary: Sets the technical direction across products.
rungs.knowledge: Sees how every system, vendor and risk fits together over years.
rungs.delivery: Sets standards and settles the hard cross-product decisions.
rungs.leadership: Advises the executive team; others come to them before they decide.
